observations: Photo shows roughly six to eight blue plastic drums with lids, some lids open showing a lighter blue inner color.
Drums are sitting on bare dirt/mud ground, outdoors, suggesting a storage yard or dealer lot.
No visible capacity markings, brand labels, or liter numbers on any drum.
A semi-transparent watermark reading something like 'SUNNY ... GENUINE' overlays the image; this is a seller/shop watermark, not an inspection stamp.
Some drums show surface scuffing and dirt stains but no visible cracks or holes in this low resolution.
Only plastic drums are visible in the photo; no steel drums are shown despite being mentioned in the text.

claims.claim: Container drums, water storage drums, plastic barrel, plastic drum and kegs
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows blue lidded plastic drums; no kegs or other drum types are visible to confirm the full range.
No steel drums appear anywhere in photo 0; claim is cut off and cannot be checked against this image.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume of each drum is unknown (e.g. 60L, 120L, 200L), which is the main price driver for drums.
risks.proof: A photo showing a printed liter marking on the drum body, or a tape measure against one drum for height/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: price at the smallest common capacity as worst case

risks.risk: Condition could be used/reconditioned rather than new, with possible cracks, prior chemical residue, or weakened lid seals not visible at this resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum walls, base, and lid gasket, plus a shot of any interior residue.

risks.risk: Food-grade vs industrial-grade plastic cannot be confirmed from a photo, affecting suitability and price for water storage.
risks.proof: A photo of a food-grade or recycling-code stamp molded into the drum (commonly on the base or side).

risks.risk: Lid seal integrity (airtight/leak-proof) is an implied but unproven feature.
risks.proof: A video clip of the lid being closed and the drum turned upside down briefly, or filled with water and checked for leaks.

risks.risk: Steel drum variant mentioned in text is not shown, so its existence/condition is unverifiable.
risks.proof: A separate photo of the actual steel drum(s) on offer.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any liter/capacity marking or stamp on one drum.
Close-up of the drum base for a food-grade/recycling code stamp.
Photo or short video showing the lid closed and the drum tipped to check for leaks.
Photo of the steel drum(s) referenced in the text, if actually available.
response.reason: The drums are identifiable by type, but the capacity that mainly sets their price is not visible or readable in the single photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without it.
